metadata.title: Sign in or create an account | Safirdex
metadata.description: Create your Safirdex account and manage your Safir collection.

aside.title: All your cards, finally in one place.
aside.description: Create an account to build your Safir collection, find the cards you are missing, and keep your progress synced over time.
aside.searchDescription: Quickly find what you are missing.

headings.signinDescription: Access your Safir collection on all your devices.
headings.signupDescription: Start with your email address and a secure password.
headings.verificationDescription: We sent a verification link to {email}.
headings.profileDescription: Choose the public information that will appear in Safirdex.

fields.pseudonymHelp: Use 3 to 24 characters with no spaces. It must be unique.
fields.displayNameHelp: This public name must also be unique.
fields.passwordHelp: Use at least 8 characters, including one letter and one number.

verification.spam: Remember to check your spam folder too.

Auth.securityNote: Your credentials are protected and managed by Firebase Authentication.

validation.weakPassword: Choose a password with at least 8 characters, including one letter and one number.
validation.emailRequiredForReset: Enter your email address before continuing.

errors.emailInUse: An account already uses this email address.
errors.invalidEmail: This email address is not valid.
errors.weakPassword: The password is not strong enough.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: The authentication service cannot be reached. Check your connection.
errors.accountInitialization: The account could not be initialized.
errors.sessionCreation: The session could not be created.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.emailNotVerified: Your address has not been verified yet. Open the link in the email first.
errors.emailRequired: Your email address must be verified first.
errors.displayNameTaken: This display name is already taken.
errors.profileSave: The profile could not be saved.

notices.verificationSent: The verification email has been sent.
notices.verificationResent: A new verification email has just been sent.
notices.passwordReset: If an account matches this address, a password reset link has just been sent.
